text: This is the staff atrium. The fountain was put in for morale. The morale left. I kept the fountain.
The pond was drained for cleaning, and nobody came back to fill it. The way on is across it. The door wants a weight, and the weight is in the pond.
Water is like paste. It is not clever. It leaves a portal exactly as fast as it arrived, and in this room it has two places to arrive.
The top bowl gives you a dribble. The long fall gives you a river. Send the long fall into the pond and wait for what floats. Then take the same fall yourself.
You filled the pond. Forty-one years of maintenance requests, and it took a courier. I have closed the ticket.
The pond is full. It has not been full since the staff picnic. There was only the one picnic.
Staff are reminded that the pond is ornamental.
